task.title: N3 independent QC: close the review findings and the N3 epic
task.objective: Run the independent QC review of N3 (closure criterion 5 of docs/plans/ai-upgrade-v5/N3-visual-locator-recovery.md) over N3.1 decideVisualAgreement and N3.3 VisualFusionStage.agree with its recover() hook and verify:visual-agreement-runtime, close its findings (Q4-a: the N2 observation and the agreement share one FD-5 400 ms budget per attempt, J9; Q8/Q9-a: the J6 A/B keeps the N2 visual block and the docs name the event-message suffix; Q8-b: the sensitive check is non-vacuous; Q8-c: retry disposition recorded), record the review in the N3 plan, ARCHITECTURE, DECISIONS and state, and close awkit-vra.4 with N3.4 and N3.5 still deferred blocked.

acceptance.description: An independent reviewer that did not write N3 reviews N3.1 and N3.3; every finding is fixed or dispositioned with a recorded reason; the agreement and the N2 recovery observation share one 400 ms budget per attempt (J9) with a mutation proving the check; the J6 A/B keeps the N2 visual block; the sensitive check cannot pass on an empty record set; the existing runner and recovery suites stay green at the final source state.

The N3 plan closure gates show criterion 5 MET with the findings table; ARCHITECTURE, DECISIONS, CURRENT_STATE, HANDOFF, TASK_LOG, ROADMAP and ImplementationRoadmap agree; awkit-vra.4 records the QC result and is closed if the tracker permits, otherwise the blocking edge is recorded as an owner action, with awkit-vra.4.4 and .4.5 still blocked; verify:roadmap-dashboard reports Sources agree.
The work lands on main and is pushed without force; the L12.27 contract stays untracked and unchanged.
